origin.description: Banded Jacobian stored with one row per diagonal.
origin.usage: jacobian.band(y, func, bandup = 1, banddown = 1, dy = NULL, time = 0, parms = NULL, pert = 1e-8, ...)

arguments.name: bandup
arguments.text: Number of nonzero bands above the diagonal of the rate Jacobian.

arguments.name: banddown
arguments.text: Number of nonzero bands below that diagonal.

arguments.name: func
arguments.text: func(time, y, parms) returns the rates.

origin.details: The matrix has bandup + banddown + 1 rows. States separated by that many positions are perturbed together. If the band is wider than the state, seq stops with 'wrong sign in by argument'.
origin.value: A banded matrix, one column per state.
origin.example:
model <- function(t, y, parms) list(-0.1 * y)
y <- c(a = 1, b = 2, c = 3, d = 4)
jacobian.band(y, model)
